extra_vocab.en: great care to avoid danger or mistakes
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公告、安全提醒和商務電子郵件，提醒對方小心或注意風險。語氣比 warning 溫和。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: caution 當「小心」時是不可數名詞，不加 s；當「一則警告」時可加 a。動詞用法常接 sb about sth 或 sb to V。

example.en: The safety cautions are printed on the back of the box.
example.zh: 安全警告印在盒子背面。

example.en: The report cautions that sales may drop next year.
example.zh: 報告提醒明年銷售可能下滑。

example.en: Our lawyer cautioned us not to sign the form yet.
example.zh: 我們的律師提醒我們先不要簽這份表格。

example.en: She is cautioning the staff about the new security rules.
example.zh: 她正在提醒員工注意新的安全規定。

example.en: Drivers must use caution near the construction site.
example.zh: 駕駛人在施工地點附近必須小心。

example.en: Please exercise caution when you open emails from unknown senders.
example.zh: 打開陌生寄件者的郵件時請保持謹慎。

example.en: We will proceed with caution until the contract is signed.
example.zh: 在合約簽署之前，我們會謹慎進行。

example.en: A word of caution: check the total before you pay.
example.zh: 提醒一下：付款前請先確認總額。

examples.en: Please use care and watch your step on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 濕地板請小心，注意腳步。

examples.en: The manager gave us a caution about spending too much this quarter.
examples.zh: 經理提醒我們本季不要花太多。

examples.en: I want to caution you that the price may change next month.
examples.zh: 我想提醒你，價格下個月可能會變。

examples.en: The airline posted a caution about heavy traffic near the airport.
examples.zh: 航空公司公告機場附近交通壅塞。

confusable.diff: careful 是形容詞，指做事小心的人；caution 是名詞，指小心的態度或警告。
confusable.usage: caution 是名詞（或動詞），careful 是形容詞，所以說 be careful，不說 be caution。

example.en: Be careful with the glass boxes in the warehouse.
example.zh: 倉庫裡的玻璃盒請小心處理。

similar.diff: warning 語氣比 caution 強，通常表示危險已經存在或問題很嚴重。

example.en: The company sent a warning letter about late payments.
example.zh: 公司寄出了關於逾期付款的警告信。

similar.diff: heads-up 是口語的提前通知，語氣輕鬆，不一定有危險。

example.en: Thanks for the heads-up about the schedule change.
example.zh: 謝謝你提前告知時間表有變動。

example.en: There is a warning sign near the machine.
example.zh: 機器旁邊有一個警告標誌。

example.en: Please handle these samples with care.
example.zh: 請小心處理這些樣品。

example.en: Every new project has some risk.
example.zh: 每個新專案都有一些風險。

example.en: Safety is our first priority at the factory.
example.zh: 工廠裡安全是我們的第一要務。

derived.link: pre-（事先）+ caution，事先小心的做法，像 prepare、prevent

example.en: Investors showed caution before the company announced its results.
example.zh: 公司公布結果之前，投資人表現得很謹慎。

example.en: I must caution you about the risks of this plan.
example.zh: 我必須提醒你這個計畫的風險。

senses.en: care taken to avoid danger or mistakes

example.en: Please handle the new equipment with great caution.
example.zh: 請非常小心地操作這台新設備。

senses.distinguish: 前面有 a／the 或 gave／received 等動詞時，通常是「一則警告」的意思。

example.en: The store gave him a caution for repeated late deliveries.
example.zh: 商店因為他一再延遲送貨給了他一次警告。

extra_vocab.en: a person who takes payment from customers in a store
extra_vocab.note: 多益購物與付款情境很常見，指商店、超市或餐廳在櫃檯收錢的人。常出現在「請到收銀台結帳」這類對話。

example.en: Two cashiers are working at the front of the store today.
example.zh: 今天店門口有兩位收銀員在工作。

example.en: She works as a cashier at a grocery store.
example.zh: 她在一家雜貨店當收銀員。

example.en: You can pay the cashier by credit card.
example.zh: 你可以用信用卡付錢給收銀員。

example.en: Please ask the cashier for a refund form at the counter.
example.zh: 請到櫃檯向收銀員索取退款表格。

example.en: The bank issued a cashier's check for the full amount.
example.zh: 銀行開出了全額的本票。

examples.en: Please take your items to the cashier on the left.
examples.zh: 請把你的商品拿到左邊的收銀員那裡。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted a paper bag.
examples.zh: 收銀員問我要不要紙袋。

examples.en: We are hiring a part-time cashier for the weekend shift.
examples.zh: 我們正在徵求週末班的兼職收銀員。

examples.en: The cashier gave me a receipt and my change.
examples.zh: 收銀員給了我收據和找零。

confusable.diff: teller 是銀行櫃員，cashier 是商店或餐廳的收銀員。

example.en: The bank teller helped me deposit the check today.
example.zh: 銀行櫃員今天幫我存入了支票。

similar.diff: clerk 範圍較廣，可指店員，也可指辦公室的文書人員，不一定負責收錢。

example.en: The sales clerk checked the stock for me.
example.zh: 店員幫我查了庫存。

example.en: Each customer received a small gift at the register.
example.zh: 每位顧客在櫃檯都收到一份小禮物。

example.en: Keep your receipt if you want to return the item.
example.zh: 如果想退貨，請保留收據。

example.en: The cash register is next to the front door.
example.zh: 收銀機在大門旁邊。

example.en: Please wait at the counter until your name is called.
example.zh: 請在櫃檯等到叫你的名字。

derived.link: cashier = cash + -ier，管現金的人，像 engineer、banker

extra_vocab.zh: 運輸業者、航空公司、電信業者
extra_vocab.en: a company or person that carries goods, people, or messages
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於貨運、航空與電信情境，指負責運送或提供服務的公司。看到 shipping carrier、mobile carrier 時要依上下文判斷是哪一種。

example.en: Several carriers can ship our packages to Europe overnight.
example.zh: 有幾家業者可以隔夜把我們的包裹寄到歐洲。

example.en: Choose a shipping carrier before you print the label.
example.zh: 列印標籤之前，請先選好貨運業者。

example.en: The air carrier cancelled two flights because of the storm.
example.zh: 這家航空公司因為暴風雨取消了兩個航班。

example.en: Your mobile carrier may charge extra for roaming.
example.zh: 你的行動電話業者可能會額外收漫遊費。

examples.en: We changed our shipping partner to save money.
examples.zh: 我們換了運送合作夥伴來省錢。

examples.en: This carrier offers several daily flights between Taipei and Tokyo.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司每天有數班往返台北和東京的航班。

examples.en: Which carrier do you use for your mobile phone?
examples.zh: 你的手機用哪一家電信業者？

examples.en: The carrier will deliver the goods within three business days.
examples.zh: 運輸業者會在三個工作天內送達貨物。

confusable.diff: career 是職涯、職業生涯，發音是 /kəˈrɪr/；carrier 是運送業者，兩個字拼法相近。

example.en: She wants to build a career in marketing.
example.zh: 她想在行銷領域發展職涯。

similar.diff: courier 指快遞員或快遞公司，強調急件與專人遞送；carrier 範圍更廣。

example.en: We sent the contract by courier this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上用快遞寄出了合約。

example.en: The freight arrived at the port on Monday.
example.zh: 貨物星期一抵達了港口。

example.en: Delivery usually takes two to three days.
example.zh: 送貨通常需要兩到三天。

example.en: The next shipment will leave the warehouse on Friday.
example.zh: 下一批貨星期五會從倉庫出發。

example.en: A large parcel is waiting for you at the front desk.
example.zh: 有一個大包裹在櫃檯等你。

derived.link: carrier = carry（y 變 i）+ -er，搬運的人或公司，像 teacher、driver
carry + -age，運送這件事（也指運費），像 package、storage

senses.en: a company that moves goods or people

example.en: The carrier offers free delivery for large orders.
example.zh: 這家運輸業者對大額訂單提供免費送貨。

senses.en: a company that provides phone or data service
senses.distinguish: 旁邊出現 phone、plan、network 等字時，通常指電信業者。

example.en: Our carrier is upgrading its network this weekend.
example.zh: 我們的電信業者這個週末要升級網路。

senses.en: a person who brings mail to homes and offices

example.en: The mail carrier delivers letters to our office every morning.
example.zh: 郵差每天早上把信送到我們辦公室。

extra_vocab.en: the person in charge of a plane, a ship, or a team
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於機場、登機廣播和旅遊情境，機上廣播常聽到 This is your captain speaking。也可指運動隊伍的隊長。

example.en: Both team captains shook hands before the game.
example.zh: 兩位隊長在比賽前握了手。

example.en: She captains the company volleyball team every summer.
example.zh: 她每年夏天擔任公司排球隊的隊長。

example.en: He captained the national team for five years.
example.zh: 他擔任國家隊隊長五年。

example.en: She is captaining the project team this quarter.
example.zh: 她這一季帶領專案團隊。

example.en: She was chosen as team captain last month.
example.zh: 她上個月被選為隊長。

example.en: He has been the captain of this ship for ten years.
example.zh: 他擔任這艘船的船長已經十年了。

example.en: Please listen to the captain's announcement before takeoff.
example.zh: 起飛前請注意聽機長廣播。

examples.en: The captain announced that the flight would be delayed.
examples.zh: 機長宣布班機會延誤。

examples.en: The captain of the soccer team thanked the fans.
examples.zh: 足球隊隊長感謝了球迷。

examples.en: The ship's captain welcomed all guests on board.
examples.zh: 船長歡迎所有賓客上船。

examples.en: The captain asked passengers to fasten their seat belts.
examples.zh: 機長請乘客繫好安全帶。

confusable.diff: caption 是圖片或照片下方的說明文字，發音 /ˈkæpʃən/；captain 是機長或隊長。

example.en: Please add a caption under each photo.
example.zh: 請在每張照片下方加上說明文字。

similar.diff: chief 是各種組織的首長或主管，不限於船或飛機。

example.en: The chief of security called a meeting.
example.zh: 安全主管召開了會議。

similar.diff: leader 是通用的領導者，可用於任何團隊；captain 多用於船、飛機和運動隊。

example.en: Our team leader sent the schedule on Monday.
example.zh: 我們的組長星期一寄出了時間表。

example.en: The pilot checked the controls before takeoff.
example.zh: 飛行員在起飛前檢查了操控裝置。

example.en: The crew prepared the cabin for the passengers.
example.zh: 機組人員為乘客準備好機艙。

example.en: A good leader listens to the whole team.
example.zh: 好的領導者會傾聽整個團隊。

example.en: Each passenger must show a passport at the gate.
example.zh: 每位乘客都必須在登機門出示護照。

example.en: The captain checked the weather report before the flight left.
example.zh: 機長在班機起飛前查看了天氣報告。

example.en: I will captain the team during the sales contest.
example.zh: 銷售競賽期間我會擔任隊長。

senses.en: the person in charge of a plane or ship

example.en: The captain landed the plane safely in heavy rain.
example.zh: 機長在大雨中安全降落了飛機。

senses.en: the leader of a sports team
senses.distinguish: 旁邊出現 team、game、players 時，通常指隊長。

example.en: Our team captain organized practice every Friday.
example.zh: 我們的隊長每週五安排練習。

extra_vocab.en: a path that electricity moves along
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於電子產品、停電和維修情境，例如 circuit board、circuit breaker。也可指一連串固定的巡迴活動。

example.en: The new phone has smaller circuits and a longer battery life.
example.zh: 這支新手機的電路更小，電池續航也更長。

example.en: A short circuit started the small fire in the office.
example.zh: 短路引起了辦公室裡的小火災。

example.en: Reset the circuit breaker if the power goes off.
example.zh: 如果停電，請重新開啟斷路器。

example.en: The engineer replaced the damaged circuit board in the printer.
example.zh: 工程師更換了印表機裡損壞的電路板。

example.en: Do not touch the electrical circuit with wet hands.
example.zh: 不要用濕手碰電路。

examples.en: The technician checked the circuit before turning on the machine.
examples.zh: 技術人員在開機前檢查了電路。

examples.en: The power went out because the circuit was overloaded.
examples.zh: 因為電路超載，所以停電了。

examples.en: The speaker travels the conference circuit every autumn.
examples.zh: 這位講者每年秋天都巡迴各個研討會。

examples.en: She is a top player on the international tennis circuit.
examples.zh: 她是國際網球巡迴賽的頂尖選手。

confusable.diff: circle 是圓圈或一群人圍成的圈；circuit 是繞一圈的路線，或電流走的電路。

example.en: Please sit in a circle for the team meeting.
example.zh: 團隊會議請圍成一圈坐。

similar.diff: tour 指旅行或巡演，比 circuit 更常見；circuit 強調固定重複的路線或系列活動。

example.en: The band will go on tour in spring.
example.zh: 這個樂團春天會去巡迴演出。

example.en: A loose wire caused the problem with the lights.
example.zh: 一條鬆脫的電線造成了燈的問題。

example.en: The power was off for two hours this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上停電了兩個小時。

example.en: The battery needs to be charged before the trip.
example.zh: 出差前電池需要先充電。

example.en: Turn off the main switch before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請關掉總開關。

senses.en: a path that electricity moves along

example.en: The circuit inside this machine is easy to repair.
example.zh: 這台機器裡的電路很容易修理。

senses.zh: 巡迴（一連串固定的場地或活動）
senses.en: a regular series of places or events visited in order
senses.distinguish: 旁邊出現 speaker、tennis、conference 等字時，通常是「巡迴」的意思。

example.en: He spent ten years on the lecture circuit.
example.zh: 他有十年時間在各地巡迴演講。

extra_vocab.en: the science of what things are made of and how they change
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於實驗室、製造與教育情境。在人事或團隊情境中，chemistry 也可指人與人之間合得來的感覺。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: chemistry 當學科是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a，動詞用單數，例如 Chemistry is difficult。

example.en: The chemistry lab opens at nine every morning.
example.zh: 化學實驗室每天早上九點開門。

example.en: The two partners have good chemistry and work well together.
example.zh: 這兩位夥伴很有默契，合作順利。

example.en: Team chemistry is important when we start a new project.
example.zh: 開始新專案時，團隊默契很重要。

examples.en: He studied chemistry at university before joining our lab.
examples.zh: 他在加入我們實驗室之前，在大學主修化學。

examples.en: The company uses chemistry to make safer cleaning products.
examples.zh: 這家公司運用化學製造更安全的清潔用品。

examples.en: You can feel the chemistry in this team during meetings.
examples.zh: 開會時你可以感受到這個團隊的默契。

confusable.diff: chemistry 是學科名稱；chemical 是「化學的」或「化學物質」。
confusable.usage: chemistry 是名詞（學科）；chemical 可當形容詞（化學的）或名詞（化學物質），可數。

example.en: The factory stores each chemical in a safe place.
example.zh: 工廠把每種化學物質存放在安全的地方。

confusable.diff: chemist 是化學家；在英式英語中也指藥局或藥劑師。

example.en: The chemist explained how the new product works.
example.zh: 這位化學家說明了新產品的原理。

similar.diff: teamwork 強調大家合作做事；chemistry 強調人與人之間合得來的感覺。

example.en: Good teamwork helped us finish the project early.
example.zh: 良好的團隊合作幫助我們提早完成專案。

example.en: She works in a science museum downtown.
example.zh: 她在市中心的科學博物館工作。

example.en: He teaches physics at a local high school.
example.zh: 他在當地一所高中教物理。

example.en: The laboratory tests every product before it is sold.
example.zh: 實驗室會在產品販售前測試每一項產品。

example.en: The first experiment was a success.
example.zh: 第一次實驗成功了。

derived.link: chem- 加 -ical，和化學有關的，像 medical、electrical
chem- + -ist，專門做這件事的人，像 artist、scientist

senses.en: the science of what things are made of and how they change

example.en: Chemistry is one of the courses required for this program.
example.zh: 化學是這個課程的必修科目之一。

senses.en: the good feeling between people who work well together
senses.distinguish: 旁邊出現 team、partners、players 等人物時，通常是「默契」的意思。

example.en: The new coach quickly built chemistry among the players.
example.zh: 新教練很快就在球員之間建立了默契。

extra_vocab.en: a regular visit to a doctor to see if you are healthy
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於醫療、員工福利和預約情境。也可指對機器或設備的例行檢查。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「做健康檢查」常說 have／get a checkup 或 go in for a checkup，介系詞用 for。

example.en: Free checkups are offered to everyone in our department.
example.zh: 我們部門的每個人都能做免費健康檢查。

example.en: I have a checkup at the clinic on Friday.
example.zh: 我星期五要去診所做健康檢查。

example.en: The annual checkup is part of our health plan.
example.zh: 年度健康檢查是我們健康方案的一部分。

example.en: A medical checkup is required before the overseas assignment.
example.zh: 外派之前必須做醫療檢查。

example.en: Please schedule a checkup before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前預約檢查。

examples.en: All employees can take a day off for a checkup.
examples.zh: 所有員工都可以請一天假去做健康檢查。

examples.en: My doctor said my checkup results look normal.
examples.zh: 我的醫生說我的檢查結果看起來正常。

examples.en: The technician gave the copy machine a full checkup.
examples.zh: 技術人員為影印機做了完整的檢查。

examples.en: Please make an appointment for your dental checkup.
examples.zh: 請預約你的牙齒檢查。

confusable.diff: checkup 是名詞（一個字）；check up 是動詞片語，分開寫，常接 on。
confusable.usage: 名詞寫成一個字 checkup；動詞片語分開寫成 check up，常用 check up on + 人或事。

example.en: I will check up on the shipping status this afternoon.
example.zh: 我今天下午會確認一下貨運狀態。

similar.diff: physical 是 physical examination 的簡稱，專指身體檢查，範圍比 checkup 窄。

example.en: He passed the physical exam for the new job.
example.zh: 他通過了新工作的體檢。

similar.diff: inspection 多指對設備、場所或產品的正式檢查，不用於人的健康。

example.en: The inspection of the factory starts on Monday.
example.zh: 工廠的檢查星期一開始。

example.en: The doctor will see you in ten minutes.
example.zh: 醫生十分鐘後會看你。

example.en: The clinic is open until six in the evening.
example.zh: 診所開到傍晚六點。

example.en: I need to change my appointment to next week.
example.zh: 我需要把預約改到下週。

example.en: Our company cares about the health of its staff.
example.zh: 我們公司很關心員工的健康。

senses.en: a visit to a doctor to see if you are healthy

example.en: She went for a checkup before starting her new job.
example.zh: 她在開始新工作之前去做了健康檢查。

senses.en: a regular check to make sure a machine works well
senses.distinguish: 旁邊出現 car、machine、system 等物品時，指設備檢查。

example.en: The car needs a checkup before the long business trip.
example.zh: 出長途差之前，這輛車需要做檢查。

extra_vocab.en: to hit your hands together to show you like something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於演講、頒獎、活動和聽力 Part 1 的人物動作題。看到人群面向台上拍手時，常用 clap 或 applaud 描述。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「為某人鼓掌」用 clap for + 人，不說 clap + 人；拍手的動作可直接說 clap your hands。

example.en: The manager always claps after each short presentation.
example.zh: 經理每次簡短報告後都會鼓掌。

example.en: The speech ended with loud claps from the audience.
example.zh: 演講在觀眾響亮的掌聲中結束。

example.en: The guests clapped when the CEO walked onto the stage.
example.zh: 執行長走上舞台時，賓客們鼓掌了。

example.en: The staff are clapping for the new team leader.
example.zh: 員工們正在為新的組長鼓掌。

example.en: The trainer asked us to clap our hands twice.
example.zh: 訓練師請我們拍兩次手。

example.en: Let's clap for our guest speaker from the head office.
example.zh: 讓我們為來自總公司的客座講者鼓掌。

example.en: Visitors were invited to clap along with the band.
example.zh: 遊客受邀跟著樂團一起拍手。

examples.en: The audience began to clap when the speaker finished.
examples.zh: 講者講完時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

examples.en: Everyone will clap for the winner at the award dinner.
examples.zh: 頒獎晚宴上，大家會為得獎者鼓掌。

examples.en: We heard a loud clap of thunder outside the office.
examples.zh: 我們在辦公室外聽到一聲響亮的雷聲。

confusable.diff: clamp 是夾緊固定的工具或動作；clap 是拍手，兩個字只差一個字母。

example.en: Use a clamp to hold the board in place.
example.zh: 用夾具把木板固定好。

similar.diff: applaud 比較正式，除了拍手，也可表示公開稱讚。

example.en: The board will applaud the team's excellent results.
example.zh: 董事會會稱讚這個團隊的優秀成績。

similar.diff: cheer 是歡呼，通常會發出聲音；clap 只是用手拍。

example.en: Staff cheer loudly when the sales target is reached.
example.zh: 達成銷售目標時，員工會大聲歡呼。

example.en: The speaker received warm applause at the end.
example.zh: 講者在結束時獲得熱烈掌聲。

example.en: The audience filled the hall before the show.
example.zh: 表演開始前，觀眾坐滿了大廳。

example.en: The president gave a short speech at the party.
example.zh: 總裁在派對上做了簡短的演講。

example.en: She won an award for the best sales record.
example.zh: 她因最佳銷售紀錄獲得了獎項。

example.en: Everyone started to clap after the president's final announcement.
example.zh: 總裁做完最後宣布後，大家開始鼓掌。

example.en: Let's give our new partners a big clap.
example.zh: 讓我們為新夥伴大大地鼓掌。

senses.en: to hit your hands together to show you like something

example.en: Please clap quietly so we can hear the next speaker.
example.zh: 請輕聲鼓掌，讓我們聽得到下一位講者。

senses.en: to hit someone lightly with your open hand
senses.distinguish: 後面接人加 on the back／shoulder 時，是拍肩膀的意思，不是鼓掌。

example.en: The boss will clap you on the back for that result.
example.zh: 老闆會為了那個成績拍拍你的背稱讚你。
